hostPlayerId.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

hostPublicKey.description: Clients verify every TURN_GRANT against this key.

playerId.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

publicKey.description: Ed25519 public key, 32 raw bytes, base64.

rig.description: The player's declared rig, for provenance (ArcAid badge, never a gate).

participants.description: Everyone accepted so far, in join order.

hostGame.description: The host's fingerprint, so a client the host accepted despite a difference (advisory mode) can show it too. null from a host that does not send it.

tableName.description: Human name of the table or ROM set.

tableHash.description: SHA-256 of the ORIGINAL .vpx (never the patched copy), or of the arcade ROM zip.

romName.description: PinMAME ROM set name (e.g. mm_109c) or arcade ROM name; null for originals.

romHash.description: SHA-256 of the ROM zip; null for originals.

physicsHash.description: Hash of the physics-relevant table settings; null when not computed.

recipeVersion.description: Castcade patch recipe version applied to this table (ADR 0004); null for arcade.

sidecarHash.description: SHA-256 of the generated sidecar .vbs; proves both players run the same patch.

emulatorVersion.description: VPX or RetroArch core version string.

anyOf.description: Everything that must match between participants for a fair match. The host compares these at HELLO.

tableMismatches.description: A8 (2026-10-31): every accepted participant whose fingerprint differs from the host's (advisory mode), with what differs, so each client can flag the others too, not only itself. Additive and defaulted, so still protocol 2: a host that does not send it reads as no differences. Not in MATCH_READY: that message is logged, and a peer that strips or defaults an unknown field would hash a different log.

playerId.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

expectedFrom.description: Which participant the host compared against.

startsInMs.description: The host starts the match in this many ms (its first game on the table, A11); null when no start is under way. A duration, not a time: the two clocks need not agree.

loading.description: Accepted participants whose table is not open yet, as the host judges from their fingerprint (A11): the match does not start from the table until this is empty.

items.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

ballEndReady.description: A13: what each participant (the host included) said about its table's ball ends (`HELLO.ballEndReady`, then `PARTICIPANT_UPDATE.ballEndReady`): `ready` false = that player's table cannot report ball ends, so its turn would never end by itself. A participant not listed is unknown. Defaulted and never logged.

playerId.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

midnightModes.description: B26.4: what each participant (the host included) said about the Midnight Madness setting on its table (`PARTICIPANT_UPDATE.midnightMode`). A participant not listed said nothing: no table open, a game with no known setting, or a companion from before B26.4. Defaulted and never logged.

playerId.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

stances.description: A17: what each member wants at the next start (`HELLO.stance`, then `PARTICIPANT_UPDATE.stance`), the host included. Absent: not a lobby; a member not listed: play.

playerId.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

stance.description: A17: Play or Watch at the next start of a match in the lobby. Never logged: a match only knows its players.

away.description: A17: members whose link is down and whose place is kept. Absent: nobody.

items.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

noCopy.description: A17: members whose PC has no copy of the lobby's table (`PARTICIPANT_UPDATE.noCopy`): they do not play a match that starts. Absent: nobody.

items.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

ownGame.description: A17: members on whose table a game the match does not own is running (`PARTICIPANT_UPDATE.ownGame`). Absent: nobody.

items.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

otherTable.description: A17: members whose open table is another game than the lobby's table. Absent: nobody.

items.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

tableChange.description: A17: members whose PC is on its way to the lobby's table after a change of it, and where each stands (`PARTICIPANT_UPDATE.tableChange`). Absent: nobody.

playerId.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

state.description: A17: `waits_game`: a game, or the entry of its initials, is on the table that is open there, and the change waits for it; `waits_person`: the person has to close the open table themselves; `offered`: the PC changes tables only when its person says so; `closing`: the open table was asked to close; `opening`: the lobby's table is being opened.

tablePickedBy.description: A17: who picked the lobby's table (`hostGame`); null or absent: the table is whatever the lobby's PC has open.

anyOf.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

ballsPerGame.description: A17: the balls per game of a match started in this lobby. Null or absent: not said.

starter.description: A17: the one member whose Start on their own table asks for a game. Null or absent: nobody is named.

anyOf.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

match.description: A17: the match that is open in the lobby; null or absent: none. A member who joins while one is open is sent its log in MATCH_LOG right after this message, and holds no log of it until the last page.

matchId.description: The Throwdown code from ArcAid, or any unique string in a local/fake match.

items.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

players.description: The players the match started with (its `MATCH_READY.playerOrder`).

game.description: The game of the match that is being played, or was played last.

state.description: `game`: a game is being played; `between`: the last game has ended and the match is still open.

start.description: A17: the start that is announced, counting down or waiting; null or absent: none. Each PC in `players` locks its table when it counts down, unless a game runs on it.

items.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

players.description: Who plays it, the first to go first.

newMatch.description: True: a new match; false: the next game of the open one.

waitsFor.description: What the start waits for; null: it is counting down (`leftMs`).

items.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

leftMs.description: The ms left of the countdown, or of the wait when it has a limit; null: no limit.

startOff.description: A17: on the one HELLO_ACK that takes an announced start away without starting anything: the sentence that says why ("Krobs cancelled the start."). Absent otherwise.

stream3dWait.description: I11.4.9: the participants (the host included) whose PC is still making its 3D connection (`PARTICIPANT_UPDATE.stream3dWaitMs`), each with the ms after which the host stops waiting for it. A start from the host's table waits until this is empty, as it waits for `loading`. A duration, not a time. A participant not listed is not waited for: its 3D connection is settled, it has none, or its companion is from before I11.4.9. Defaulted and never logged.

playerId.description: Stable participant id for this match: the ArcAid user id, or a fakeclient label.

hostTableObjects.description: I11.4.15: the identity the Castcade VPX build gives the host's table (its `hello`'s `<editables> <table hash>`): what two PCs must have in common for the 3D view, where `hostGame.tableHash` only says whether the bytes are the same. As the host's VPX said it, or, before that, as the host's companion computed it from the file. A joining PC uses it to pick, among its copies of the table, one the 3D view works with. null: not known (no table open, a file it cannot be told from, a companion from before I11.4.15). Compared only, never a gate. Defaulted and never logged.

editables.description: How many table objects (editables) the host's table has once loaded.

hash.description: 64-bit FNV-1a over each object in order: its item type (u32), the length of its name (u32) and the name (UTF-16LE); 16 hex digits, lower-case.

description: host -> client. The HELLO was accepted; the match is not ready until MATCH_READY. Sent again to every client while in the lobby when a PARTICIPANT_UPDATE (or the host itself) changed the roster or the host fingerprint. In a lobby (A17) it is the lobby as it is now, and is sent to every member on every change in every phase, also while a match is played.
